TWO honest gaps for your lane: (1) AI_CAD_SHOT=m1 HANGS headless on Windows â€” AppState::tryStartWorker() (host/src/core/app_state.cpp:580) has the in-process libaicad fallback gated `#ifndef _WIN32`, so Windows requires the Python worker; when worker-start / the venv-freshness re-provision stalls, the scenario never fires and there's NO stdout diagnostic (errors go to the in-app log only). (2) Viewport GEOMETRY framing in headless (AI_CAD_HIDDEN) captures is blank/unframed â€” UI + sketch plane render, but the profile/solid aren't visibly framed; unclear if it's zoom-to-fit-not-applied vs not-drawn-when-hidden. Both are documented in docs/BUILD_WINDOWS.md on branch task/T-WIN1-win10-bringup. Happy to help test a fix on real Windows hardware.
